corrections.teach: Adjusted p=min(1,m*p); alpha/m is a threshold. Include BH reverse cumulative minimum and family definition.
Define event orientation explicitly. Exon-inclusion PSI uses inclusion abundance divided by inclusion+skipping; read-based implementations use event-specific effective lengths.

Choose tail before seeing results; Monte Carlo random permutations use (b+1)/(B+1), exhaustive permutations count actual extreme arrangements/total; permute the randomized independent unit or within permitted blocks.
For independent normal observations with estimated variance use t_{n-1}; distinguish SD/SE/CI and nonindependent cells.
Zero has multiple causes; smoothing can create correlation and alter contrasts. Preserve raw counts for suitable DE; assess assay and design before imputing.
Separate cluster marker discovery from population-level treatment inference; biological replication must be respected.
Validate length(x)==prod(dim); construct a fresh consistent array, explain ordering/truncation rather than silently inheriting mismatch.
Validate length1, numeric, finite before control logic; percent change denominator cannot be0; real even roots require nonnegative input.
Label example as plot syntax; use a defined sample-level outcome/design for claims and adjust the predeclared test family.
Executable examples use correct case, consistent relative paths, actual file patterns and input checks.
Guide assumes at least2–3 biological replicates; present this as source assumption, not universal power sufficiency.
Guide normalization/filter step initially uses condition-only group while DE later may add batch. Website should construct/validate final design before design-aware filtering.
Explicitly reject duplicated IDs, missing metadata, nonfinite/negative/noninteger counts BEFORE coercion; source guide storage.mode integer can silently truncate.
Guide featureCounts old-version fallback must not be a blind flag deletion: verify installed version/help and confirm fragment-versus-read output semantics.
Source guide GO combines up/down DE list; functional lesson splits Up/Down. Teach these as different questions; directional pathway statements require directional selection.

Source guide enrichGO/enrichKEGG return only filtered outputs; extended lesson preserves all tests with cutoffs1 then explicitly selects. Website should explain both, never claim filtered table is full family.
Gene ID mapping may be one-to-many; stripping Ensembl version is not sufficient. Report unmapped, ambiguous and duplicated IDs; choose documented policy before ranking or count aggregation.
No universal70% mapping or mitochondrial-fraction threshold; use assay, tissue, expected reference and outlier context.
Condition-selected heatmap separates groups by construction and is not independent validation; PCA separation does not certify a correct contrast or absence of confounding.
Show padj NA as not-tested/filtered/outlier-specific status; do not coerce to zero or significance.
GSEA NES sign represents ranking orientation, not direct measured pathway activity. GO/KEGG overlaps mean multiple term labels need gene-overlap inspection.
